messages:
Mara (AE): ACME needs a one-paragraph CAIQ response clarifying who manages encryption keys across Hosted / Dedicated / Private, whether BYOK is supported, and what attestation/audit evidence we can provide. POC kickoff Wed. Can someone draft a short paste-ready snippet?

Alex (Security): Paste-ready snippet for CAIQ:

"Key management: For Redwood Hosted customers, Redwood manages encryption-at-rest keys using our cloud KMS; keys are rotated per our internal key rotation policy and stored under Redwood's KMS control. For Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments we support customer-owned keys (BYOK) through integrations with customer KMS endpoints; in BYOK configurations customers retain sole control of key material and Redwood never has access to unwrapped key material. Backup and snapshot data are encrypted under the same KMS policies as primary data. Key usage logs and KMS access telemetry are available for audit in all deployment modes."

Alex (Security): We can also provide a signed attestation letter for BYOK deployments stating Redwood does not hold customer key material. :white_check_mark:

Linh (Eng-Infra): Ops note: Dedicated supports rotation hooks and we can coordinate rotation windows with the customer's ops team. BYOK onboarding requires a short SOW addendum and access to the customer's KMS endpoint for initial configuration; we'll need the KMS endpoint, principal, and any firewall allowlist entries. I'll create an internal runbook ticket (OPS-4521) to capture steps and verify rotation test steps.

Alex (Security): For CAIQ mapping: link the snippet to CC-EN-1, CC-PR-3, and the SIG encryption custody sections. If they ask about key lifecycle or HSM-specific attestations, we can include our SOC2 scope and provide KMS usage logs export for the audit period.

Sam (Solutions): I'll update the CAIQ response doc with Alex's text and attach the attestation template. I'll also flag the onboarding ticket and add the BYOK SOW checklist to the POC board.

Mara (AE): Standard phrasing is perfect to start. If ACME requests BYOK we'll attach the SOW steps and propose a rotation window during onboarding. Thanks team :thumbsup:

redwood-bot: CAIQ draft uploaded -> https://drive.redwood.company/drive/CAIQ-drafts/1861234567

Mara (AE): Added to the sales packet and POC checklist. Closing unless ACME asks for more detail.
